_comment: AGENTIC-TESTING-PLAN.md Phase 5 / issue #154. Scoped deliberately to pure-logic modules where mutants are meaningful and runs stay fast. wos-plus-main.ts (DOM-coupled orchestration) is explicitly excluded per the issue.
_thresholds_comment: Measured baseline (PR landing #154): 79.31% overall (board-utils.ts 94.85, cors.ts 93.18, launch-menu.ts 43.28, mirror-url.ts 94.23, twitch-channel.ts 61.11, wos-words.ts 72.19). break is set just below that measured number, not guessed, per the issue's instruction. Documented target is >=70 on scoped modules; several files are already well past that, so break tracks the real (higher) floor instead of the aspirational minimum. Raise it as coverage improves; never lower it to get green.
